full_video.title: How One Family Became Richer Than Kings

reels.title: Britain Needed £4 Million by Monday
reels.caption:
1875: Britain had days to buy into the Suez Canal and Parliament wasn't sitting. Disraeli sent his secretary to one man, Lionel de Rothschild.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Locked In One Street Every Night
reels.caption:
Frankfurt, 1744. Jewish families were forced onto one walled street, the Judengasse, and locked in at night. The Rothschild story starts here.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Banking in Napoleon's Wartime Europe
reels.caption:
Napoleon's wars changed this family's fortunes. When the French arrived, Prince William fled, and Mayer Rothschild kept the prince's money safe and working.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Five Sons, Five Capitals
reels.caption:
Mayer Rothschild sent his sons to Frankfurt, Vienna, London, Naples and Paris. The family crest became five arrows tied together.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Letters Most of Europe Couldn't Read
reels.caption:
The five brothers wrote constantly, sometimes in Yiddish written in Hebrew letters. News reached the others within days, and that was worth a fortune.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Waterloo Rothschild Story Is a Myth
reels.caption:
The famous tale says Nathan faked a panic after Waterloo and bought bonds cheap. Historians call it a myth, spread later by pamphlets, some openly antisemitic.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: From the Ghetto to Barons
reels.caption:
After 1815 the real money came slowly, from lending to governments. In 1822 the Austrian emperor made all five brothers barons.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: When Belgium Needed a Loan to Survive
reels.caption:
When Belgium broke away in 1830, the new country needed money to get going, and Rothschild loans helped. Brazil borrowed too when it split from Portugal.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Britain Paid Slave-Owners £15 Million in 1835
reels.caption:
When Britain abolished slavery, it borrowed £15 million to compensate slave-owners, much of it through Nathan Rothschild's bank. The freed people got nothing.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: He Refused One Oath for 11 Years
reels.caption:
Lionel de Rothschild would not swear a Christian oath, so he couldn't take his seat. In 1858 he became the first practising Jewish MP.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: When Empires Went Broke, They Called One Family
reels.caption:
Austria's first big railway, the Habsburg finances, France's 5 billion franc payment to Germany: the Rothschilds raised the loans.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: The Worst-Timed Wine Purchase in History
reels.caption:
The Rothschilds bought Mouton and Lafite just before a tiny insect, phylloxera, wiped out most of France's vineyards.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Diamonds, Oil, Then Shell
reels.caption:
They helped finance De Beers in 1888, took on Rockefeller in Baku oil, then sold out to Royal Dutch Shell for shares in 1911.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: He Drove Zebras to Buckingham Palace
reels.caption:
Walter Rothschild filled a museum with hundreds of thousands of specimens, rode a giant tortoise, and drove a zebra carriage to the palace.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels

reels.title: Are the Rothschilds Worth Trillions?
reels.caption:
No. The fortune was split among many heirs over two centuries. Today Rothschild & Co is an advisory bank, plus famous vineyards.
Watch the full video on our YouTube channel.
#Rothschilds #History #Banking #Animation #HistoryReels
